The description of the park as a "festival of colors" and the imagery of swirling leaves create a visually rich and inviting atmosphere. The mention of couples and children playing adds a sense of communal joy and innocence, while the phrase "wistful atmosphere of change" introduces a touch of melancholy or reflection associated with the season's transition. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by establishing a serene and picturesque setting that contrasts with or enhances the emotional state of the characters, emphasizing themes of passage of time, comfort, and the beauty of natural cycles.
